head: claude/exit-integrity-cluster
title: feat(ops): reconcile DECLARED vs RESTING brackets — the price axis nothing checks; + a board-post relay
body:
Tier 1 throughout — a read-only audit script, its tests, and a CI relay. **No `src/`, no `config/`, no unit file, no order path, no VM mutation.**

Opened via `pr-opener.yml` because this session's GitHub MCP is **403 on writes** (`Resource not accessible by integration`) — the same 403 `claude-pr-automerge.yml`'s header documents.

---

## 1. `scripts/ops/broker_bracket_reconcile.py` — the detector

`IBClient.protection_coverage` has been corrected twice, each time on a different axis of one question:

1. `BL-20260814-IB-PROTECTION-BOOLEAN-NOT-QUANTITY` — it answered a **boolean**. Fixed to a **quantity**.
2. `BL-20260816-COVERAGE-IS-ONE-SIDED` — it graded a stop and a take-profit as interchangeable. Fixed to two **sides**.

**It is still blind to a third axis: PRICE.** Its verdict is `{size, covered_qty, stop_qty, target_qty, legs, unknown_qty_legs, oca_groups, source}` — no price in it, and no price in any consumer. Measured 2026-08-20: `auxPrice` appears in `src/` **exactly once** (`list_open_orders`, the surface that merely dumps rows — no consumer), and `aux_price`/`lmt_price` appear in `scripts/` **zero** times. Nothing anywhere compares a resting protective leg's price to `trades.stop_loss` / `trades.take_profit_1`.

### The live consequence

`ib_paper`, 2026-08-20T20:23:39Z, `read_state: orders_read`:

| sym | trade | pos | declared SL | resting STP | Δ | declared TP | resting LMT |
|---|---|--:|---|---|---|---|---|
| MHG | 4796 | 29 | 6.221714 | 6.2215 | ✓ | 7.141302 | 7.1415 ✓ |
| MGC | 4773 | 95 | 4371.1469 | 4371.1 | ✓ | 4393.0207 | **NONE** |
| MES | 4350 | 15 | 7533.696429 | **7516.50** | **69 ticks** | 8390.5903 | **NONE** |

**MES is protected 17.196 points below its declared stop — $1,289.73 on 15 contracts ($5/pt).** It graded FULLY STOP-COVERED the whole time: the quantity was right (15 of 15) and the side was right. Only the price was wrong, and nothing looks at the price. MGC and MHG match their journals to within a tick in the same read, so this is a genuine outlier rather than a rounding artifact.

It is also a **direct consequence of the over-cover remediation**: `BL-20260816-IB-STOPS-OVER-COVER-IN-DISJOINT-OCA-GROUPS` records order 375 @ 7533.75 (matches the journal within one tick) and order 338 @ 7516.5 (does not). 375 was cancelled and 338 kept — the leg that matched the journal was the one removed, which is what that row's own criterion #1 was written to prevent.

### What it checks

| finding | axis |
|---|---|
| `stop_naked` / `stop_partial` | quantity |
| `stop_over_cover` | quantity — **ports the Bybit `over_covered` signal to IB**, criterion #3 of the over-cover row |
| `stop_disjoint_oca` | the naked-short hazard — `ocaType=1` cancels the rest of the *same* group and says nothing about a different one |
| `target_naked_declared` / `target_partial_declared` | side, **declared-only** |
| `stop_price_diverges` / `target_price_diverges` | **price — new** |
| `coverage_ungradeable` | an unreadable leg qty is not a clean grade |

**Declared-only on the target side, deliberately.** A missing stop is a safety gap that may be closed blind; a missing target is decision-time geometry that must be READ from `trades.take_profit_1`, never invented. A trade declaring no target yields `target_absent_undeclared` — an INFO state, not a finding. Imposing a target on a strategy that never chose one is a Tier-3 strategy question.

**Three-state, never collapsed.** `not_ib` / `could_not_look` / `reconciled`. A `could_not_look` account reports `findings: null`, never `0`, and gets its own exit code (3) — a fabricated clean bill for an account nobody read is the collapse this whole family of bugs is made of.

### Verification

- **MHG is the discriminating control.** Against today's live payloads the detector **passes MHG and flags MGC + MES**. A detector that flags all three is as broken as one that flags none, so the control is asserted beside every positive.
- `--self-test` **19/19**; `pytest` **28/28**; `ruff` clean.
- **Verified red-capable, not assumed**: planting an LMT-first classifier (the inversion that would *manufacture* target coverage) fails 4 tests including the parity check against `ib_client._protective_leg_side`.
- Tick sizes are read from `config/instruments.yaml` rather than hardcoded — an earlier draft of this analysis used 12500 for MHG's multiplier when the config says 2500, which is exactly why the field is read.

## 2. `.github/workflows/board-post.yml` — the missing relay

The coordination-board `▶️ START` on issue #6927 is **mandatory before a session's first substantive tool call**, but a PM-side session's MCP is intermittently read-only and `add_issue_comment` 403s. Relays existed for the PR half of that 403 (`pr-opener.yml`, `claude-pr-automerge.yml`) and **none existed for the board half** — so a read-only session was structurally unable to comply with a binding rule; its only moves were to skip the board or stop.

Stricter than the `pr-opener.yml` it is modelled on, in two ways chosen for this artifact: an **empty body is refused** rather than posted (a blank comment reads as compliance while saying nothing), and **a failed post fails the run** rather than recording `FAILED:` and exiting 0 (a session that believes it claimed the board and did not is invisible to every other session *and to itself*).

Blast radius: comments on one hardcoded issue number. It cannot open, close, label or edit an issue, cannot touch a PR, and cannot reach `src/`, `config/`, a unit file, or either VM.

---

Draft. Findings, grading of the seven cluster rows, and the Tier-3 items are on the board.
